newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Command says makes profit in Sept qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Command says makes profit in Sept qtr.

text.p: Oil producer Command Petroleum Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday unaudited profit was A$4.67 million for the three months ended September 30, compared with a loss of A$1.62 million a year earlier.

Command said production for the quarter was 244,232 barrels of oil or 2,655 barrels of oil per day, a 169 percent increase compared with the previous quarter, due to production rate increases at the Ravva Field in India.
The Australian oil group is currently in a A$365 million agreed merger with Cairn Energy Plc of the United Kingdom.
Command said its working capital was A$22.70 million at September 30, 1996, which includes cash and short term deposits of A$19.43 million.
At 1.15 p.m. (0115 GMT), Command shares were steady at A$1.12.
